name: Thrivve Partners
description: An agile consultancy from Soho, London. Thrivve coach organisations on flow, product leadership and delivery, and run Loft Learning, free hands-on learning days for practitioners. We run workshops together.

name: Lil Agile Monster
description: A flow metrics and Kanban consultancy founded by Liz Rettig. Lil Agile Monster helps teams and portfolios become predictable enough to plan a business around, pairing flow discipline with agentic AI. Liz is a Professional Kanban Trainer with ProKanban.org and uses Lighthouse in her client work.

name: Value Talks
description: Value Talks is a consultancy for organisation development, founded by Ari Byland. It works with senior management on product organisation, co-leadership, decision-making and AI. Besides consulting, Value Talks runs trainings, workshops and a podcast.
